polityNote: State / Federal Islamic Republic / Union of the Comoros from independence (1975-07-06), without Mayotte, which stayed under French administration (claimed by the Comoros; drawn as France). First-level units are the three islands (governorates; autonomous islands from 2002). Atoms are geoBoundaries COM ADM1 (OpenStreetMap, ODbL), one per island with its islets. Anjouan (and briefly Mohéli) seceded de facto 1997–2002; the dossier follows the de jure administration. Independent check (①): atom areas vs statoids areas — Anjouan 428 vs 424 km², Grande Comore 1,019 vs 1,148, Mohéli 208 vs 290 (statoids figures are the commonly quoted round values; the OSM coastlines are the drawn ones).
